name: Thundering Hearts
label: Quest
description: Thundering Hearts: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Fascinating, aren't they? This is the first time I have ever been privy to the secrets of abomination creation.
I have been studying these notes, and it appears we need a heart. A massive one!

I hear there is a thunder lizard there of impressive size called Stormheart, that patrols along the canyon edge in Thousand Needles. With a name like that it must have the perfect heart. I must have that heart!
Oh, also I suggest you bring friends. Stormheart isn't known for being docile.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Oh, you've returned in one piece! Pity, if you hadn't your bones and what's left of your flesh would have made excellent fodder for my tinkering.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent! I can hardly contain my excitement. Oh, and the heart still has electrical pulses? That's impressive. I won't have to shock it back to life then!
This heart will be a wonderful addition to the abomination, and certainly looks to be the specified size, if these notes are correct.
Ah, I love it when a plan comes together.
